text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mm... Mmm! Sigh... These haskapsare perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for sharing your<n>extras! And
I'm super glad that little<n>taste-test I did left such a
lasting<n>impression on you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You've spoken to the farmer over the<n>phone, right?
I've known her since I<n>was little. She was so
happy for me<n>when I left home for Tracen, and
even<n>made me business cards...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh! No, I'm fine! I just got distracted<n>for a second,
that's all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...With how stretched thin she's been,there most definitely is something up.And I think I know what.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I've gotta be the star of Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha, wh-why would you think<n>that?
choice_data_list: It's written all over your face...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh no. I, I had no idea...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I offer to listen if there's anything she<n>wants to get
off her chest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She hesitates for a moment, then<n>resigns herself
and begins talking.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I lived in Tomakomai ever since I can<n>remember.
It's a small town with a<n>big open sky, where you
can always<n>taste the ocean on the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
On the weekends, I'd go to the port to<n>watch the
ships coming in. And I'd<n>ride my bicycle out to one
of the<n>parks, or to visit the lake...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But the more I visited my favorite<n>places, the more I
started to notice<n>how they were changing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I saw places stop opening their<n>shutters on
business days. Dust<n>piling up on storefront
displays. I<n>saw... the Tomakomai I loved quietly
dying away.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I couldn't believe it. I mean, I'd heardabout the declining population, but...well, that was when it dawned onme—it was happening to us.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we couldn't get more people in<n>town, the
businesses would keep on<n>withering away... And
that<n>realization—it was terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I had to fight back somehow, so I<n>started
performing as a local idol.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident
text_block_list.text:
So this "local idol" thing is a perform'r<n>that brings
tourists to their local area?<n>Huh. So basic'lly, you'd
be our PR<n>mascot?

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! For example, I'll sing and<n>dance to
hopefully catch people's<n>attention and get them
interested in<n>us.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The only thing is, if I perform on the<n>streets here, no
one's going to see it<n>but locals. I've been racking
my<n>brains trying to think of somewhere<n>more
effective.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident
text_block_list.text:
I might have the perfect idea, actually.<n>There's a
special kind of concert just<n>for talented young
Umamusume like<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm Hokko Tarumae from Tomakomai<n>City! I'll be
singing "Stop On by<n>Tomakomai"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I joined a junior runners' club and<n>started entering
races. And then in the<n>winning concerts, I'd
advertise<n>Tomakomai—and it was going pretty<n>well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But then one day, someone who<n>worked in the
Tokyo racing scene<n>was visiting, and they came to
talk to<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I go to Tracen Academy and enter<n>the Twinkle
Series, I'll be able to<n>share Tomakomai with way
more<n>people, huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy... I never considered<n>going
anywhere, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I figured it might be my big chance. If I<n>joined the
Twinkle Series, I could<n>potentially advertise my
hometown on<n>a national scale.

text_block_list.name: Young Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I want to try it. I'll share Tomakomai<n>with the
whole country!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I doubled down on my training, and<n>made it into the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best! I swear, I'll<n>revitalize
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I was all pumped to get out there<n>and make my
dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But in reality, neither my racing or my<n>idol activities
are going well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...The folks back home sent me off<n>with the
warmest smiles. They made<n>me a sash and
business cards... and<n>had such high hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I don't bring in customers, it's<n>probably just a
matter of time until<n>another business closes. The
Tomakomai I love will just keep<n>getting smaller.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: And yet... nothing I do is working!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so? ...Hehe, then she's still<n>plugg'n away
at her dreams, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"She's a real insp'ration, that girl.<n>Why, I even
made an account on the<n>social medias to try my
own hand at<n>some PR!"

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe seeing the influence she's<n>had will ease
her mind. I pull open<n>"the social medias" and find
the<n>farmer's page.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ... Blog updates, online order info,<n>regular events...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, she worked with city hall to<n>hold a big
event. Just look how many<n>people went! I never
knew she did<n>stuff like... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's a blog article about me...<n>"Thinking About
Hokko Tarumae, Our<n>Tomakomai Idol."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I hope everything's going just<n>peachy down in
Tokyo. She's been<n>working herself real hard to
liven up<n>Tomakomai, but sometimes I worry<n>she
might be working herself TOO<n>hard."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"At the end of the day, I just hope<n>she's having
fun. Us old folks can<n>handle the business side of
Tomakomai. I guess I should probably<n>tell her that
next time I see her."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone spots Tarumae down in<n>Tokyo, watch
over her for me. She's<n>our little gem, so take real
good care<n>of her."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've been... so naive! I overestimated<n>myself...
There's no way the people<n>back home would make
me shoulder<n>Tomakomai's fate alone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The sash, the business cards... all the
encouragement... This whole time,<n>they just wanted
to help me achieve<n>my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: They've done so much, all for me...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I've been such an idiot! What on<n>earth am I doing?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The folks back home are so kind!<n>They're so
caring! And they've been<n>supporting my dreams
this whole<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I... I'll work harder! I want to give<n>back to them!
I'll show the world how<n>wonderful Tomakomai is!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Will you be my trainer, and<n>teach me how
to run?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There's another scrimmage soon,and I have to win it. I'll win, andfinally become someone that Tomakomai can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But to do that, I need to brush up my<n>skills. I need a
professional's<n>guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And with her mind firmly set, HokkoTarumae promptly gets my signatureon a training contract.
